Residents:
Felix (30s) and Aisha (40s) work in town offices. Weekdays: out ~08:00–17:30, home evenings. Weekends: sleep in, errands midday, home rest of day. Felix hobbies: family calls, knitting, movies. Aisha hobbies: family calls, movies, houseplants, running.

Object Locations (Sun 23:59):
Balcony: Floor has watering can. Table has spray bottle, gardening gloves.
Bathroom: Shelf has detergent, laundry basket, Aisha’s skincare, Felix’s skincare. Med cabinet has Aisha’s meds, Felix’s toiletry bag. Sink has soap, toothbrush holder, Felix’s razor, Aisha’s razor. Rack has towels.
Bedroom 1: Floor has ironing board. Desk has Aisha’s laptop, Felix’s charger, Felix’s laptop, Aisha’s notebook, Aisha’s pen, Aisha’s headphones. Dresser has Felix’s hair dryer. Nightstand has books, Aisha’s book, Aisha’s glasses, Aisha’s tablet, Felix’s tablet. Bed has Aisha’s tablet, Felix’s headphones. Wardrobe empty.
Entry: Floor has toolbox, Felix’s umbrella, vacuum, Aisha’s backpack. Hook has Felix’s backpack, Felix’s jacket, Felix’s scarf, Aisha’s jacket, Aisha’s scarf. Table has Felix’s keys, Felix’s wallet, Aisha’s keys, Aisha’s wallet. Shoe rack has Aisha’s shoes, Felix’s shoes.
Kitchen: Counter has kettle, knives, toaster, Felix’s vitamins, clock, water_bottle_aisha. Cupboard has duster, Aisha’s mug, Felix’s mug, Felix’s lunchbox, Aisha’s bowl, Felix’s bowl, Aisha’s glass, Aisha’s plate, Felix’s plate, snack bowl. Drawer has kitchen knife. Table has fruit bowl, Felix’s plate, serving dish, Felix’s water bottle, glass_felix. Pantry has shopping bag. Sink has bowls, cutting board, pan, spatula, kitchen knife. Dish rack has Aisha’s water bottle. Chair/Floor empty.
Living: Armchair has cushion 2. Bookshelf has frame, speaker, vase, board game. Coffee table has candle, coasters, tissues, remote, Aisha’s glass, Aisha’s mug, Felix’s tablet. Couch has blanket, cushion 1, Felix’s knitting bag. Side table has lamp. TV stand has remote. Floor empty.
Office: All spots empty.

Notes:
Both residents leave for work around 08:00, taking personal items (phones, keys, wallets, bags, laptops, water bottles, outerwear, shoes) with them. They return around 17:30–19:00, placing these items back in the entryway or kitchen. On weekends, both residents take their phones out of the house for midday errands (observed Sun 16:00) and return them to the bedroom by evening. Felix’s phone returns to the dresser; Aisha’s phone returns to the nightstand.

Kitchen items follow a strict cycle: dirty dishes are washed and moved to the cupboard/dish rack in the late evening (20:32). Clean items are moved to the sink/counter in the early morning (00:00) and midday (14:34) for use. Shared tools (knife, pan, spatula, cutting board) are moved to the counter in the evening (20:02) for cooking, then back to the sink/drawer by 20:32.

In the evening, both residents move work electronics (laptops, chargers, headphones, notebooks, pens) to the bedroom desk. Aisha moves her book, glasses, and tablet from the nightstand to the bed in the late evening. In the late evening, they move snacks and drinks from the kitchen to the living room coffee table for movie time. Felix’s tablet moves from the coffee table to the nightstand in the late afternoon (16:00). Aisha’s backpack moves from the hook to the entry floor in the late afternoon (16:00).
